subject: Finalizing GCP private offer — commit smoothing, ledger mapping & billing cadence
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Duncan <tim.duncan@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing GCP private offer — commit smoothing, ledger mapping & billing cadence

Tim —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our convo, Acme is targeting a private offer but wants the consumption committed over the next 12 months to be smoothed across quarters for internal forecasting and to match a separate GCP marketplace revenue recognition flow.

Attached is the latest PO draft and a suggested drawdown schedule that smooths the commit into even monthly buckets but includes a frontloaded onboarding credit in month 1. Can you confirm:

- Whether GCP needs a single invoice per quarter or accepts monthly chargebacks tied to the private-offer drawdown?
- Whether Acme can provide a finance ledger mapping (GL codes) we should emit on invoice metadata so your AP can auto-route?
- Any constraints on the private-offer expiration or redemption window we should be aware of for billing cutoffs?

We'd like to get contracting & finance aligned so the DocuSign flow can go out next week. Looping Marissa for revenue/co-sell mapping and Karthik for the expected marketplace SKU mapping.

Next steps I propose:
1) Acme confirms preferred invoice cadence and shares GL mappings (if needed).
2) GCP contracting issues final private-offer terms; we reconcile any differences and send DocuSign.
3) Redwood issues initial invoice/invoice schedule matching the drawdown once PO is signed.

Attachments: redwood_gcp_po_draft_v3.pdf, proposed_drawdown_schedule.xlsx

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Tim Duncan <tim.duncan@acme.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@acme.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing GCP private offer — commit smoothing, ledger mapping & billing cadence

Alex,

Appreciate the summary and the draft PO. Quick answers from our side:

- Acme prefers monthly invoices tied to actual drawdown usage rather than a single quarterly invoice. Keeps our internal cashflow aligned to consumption.
- We'll supply GL mappings but we'd like Redwood to emit a PO number + "GCP-MP-PRIVATE" tag on each invoice line so our AP can identify marketplace vs direct spend. I'll attach our GL export.
- Regarding expiration: we can accept a 90-day redemption window from signing, but need the ability to frontload up to 20% in the first 30 days for early onboarding credits.

I've attached a short CSV with our ledger codes and a sample AP contact. If you need anything from procurement/legal, tell me who to pull in.

—Tim
Tim Duncan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing GCP private offer — commit smoothing, ledger mapping & billing cadence

Alex / Karthik —

Quick notes from rev ops/co-sell:

- Marketplace co-sell credits: we need to reconcile how GCP issues co-sell credits (if any) for private offers. If attribution is handled by a Marketplace SKU we should record the SKU in our internal revenue tool (Stripe/NetSuite mapping).
- If Acme provides GL codes, we can map them into our AR export but only if the invoice metadata includes both the PO number and the marketplace SKU. Otherwise manual rework will be required.
- I'll prepare a mapping table for NetSuite and share a suppressed example file (no PII) by EOD. That will include NL account codes and product-level revenue buckets.

Also, Karthik — please confirm the SKU and whether the committed units are per-token or per-inference-unit so we can surface the right line item.

-M
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: GCP Partner Contracting <contracting@gcp-partner.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Tim Duncan <tim.duncan@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing GCP private offer — commit smoothing, ledger mapping & billing cadence

Hi Alex / Tim —

Thanks for the details. We can support monthly chargebacks tied to the private-offer drawdown. A few items for clarity before we finalize terms:

1) Billing metadata: GCP will echo back an "order_reference" and allows a custom "partner_tag" field (up to 32 chars) which you can use for the "GCP-MP-PRIVATE" tag. Please confirm the exact string.
2) Redemption window: 90 days is fine. Frontloading up to 20% is acceptable but must be explicitly called out in the offer terms.
3) Invoice cadence: We'll accept monthly invoices but note the official reconciliation will happen quarterly on the GCP reconciliation report — payment terms are still standard net-30.

I've generated a private-offer PDF with the frontloaded credit and the 90-day redemption window. Sending DocuSign to both parties now: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?p=abc1234

Attachments: GCP_private_offer_Acme_2026-09.pdf

Let me know the exact "partner_tag" and we will insert it into the back-end metadata.

Regards,
GCP Partner Contracts
contracting@gcp-partner.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Duncan <tim.duncan@acme.ai>, GCP Partner Contracting <contracting@gcp-partner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing GCP private offer — commit smoothing, ledger mapping & billing cadence

All —

Thanks, everyone. Confirming the partner_tag value: GCP-MP-PRIVATE-ACME. Marissa — we'll expect your NetSuite mapping file today and will include the recommended SKU in the invoice metadata. Karthik — please confirm SKU: RDW-GCP-SKU-STD-1P and whether committed units are measured as "token-units" (preferred) or "inference-units".

Tim — once DocuSign is complete (GCP link above) we'll kick off the signed PO -> invoice schedule. I'll also attach the redlined PO that reflects the 20% frontload in month 1 for your procurement team to confirm.

Next steps summary:
- Acme signs DocuSign by 10/04 (target).
- GCP finalizes backend partner_tag and confirms monthly reconciliation export format.
- Redwood issues initial invoice schedule and includes PO + partner_tag metadata for AP automation.

Thanks —
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
